entries.label: A soft little bow
entries.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production sprite sheet for the ORIGINAL Moru seal in reference1; preserve this exact character identity. Create exactly1024x2048 pixels, FOUR columns by EIGHT rows of256x256 square cells, 32 sequential unique incremental poses in row-major order. Exactly32 cells, NO cell lines, captions, letters, grid or panel borders. True alpha0 transparent background, opaque hard-edged pixel art; no gradients, glow, shadows, blur, texture or soft alpha. Flat navy #171923, gray #d6d3c9, ivory #fff1d7, indigo #6d73d2 and muted indigo #50569c. Same low round gray seal, ivory cheeks and belly, paired navy eyes, tiny solid diamond nose, two whisker strokes each cheek, short indigo FRONT FLIPPERS, curled forked LEFT tail with ivory notch. No human arms, hands or legs. Fixed camera, same actor scale70%cellwidth, baseline at78%cellheight, at least10%empty cell margin everywhere. Keep face, eyes and nose clear. ACTION: a warm tiny bow acknowledging the viewer. Frames1-4 calm anticipation and paired blink;5-12 head and round body gradually lean forward in EIGHT tiny increments while flippers stay planted,13-16 hold the lowest bow with soft smiling eyes;17-24 gently return in EIGHT tiny increments;25-28 one short front flipper gives a tiny welcoming wave;29-32 settle to the EXACT same neutral as frame1. Keep belly planted, body volume stable, never flatten into a puddle, never change body scale. Tail follows the body with a small delayed bend. Changes from one neighboring cell to the next must be small, continuous, deliberate and anatomically coherent; do not fill cells with random independent poses. First and last frame identical. One seal only, no props.

entries.label: A tiny hat greeting
entries.action: One Moru tips a small unbranded indigo top hat with ivory band. Frames1-4 neutral WITHOUT hat;5-8 a short front flipper draws the little hat from behind its flank;9-12 gently lifts hat upward BESIDE the face;13-16 places it on top of the gray head;17-20 tilts its head politely and lifts the brim with one short flipper without hiding either eye or nose;21-24 takes hat off to the SIDE,25-28 lowers it behind its flank,29-32 returns to exact neutral without hat. Keep hat small enough that its top always remains below the10%top margin. Cute seal anatomy, no human hand gripping fingers.

entries.label: Blanket peekaboo
entries.action: One Moru plays peekaboo using a tiny folded indigo blanket with an ivory edge held between its TWO SHORT front flippers. The blanket rests low in front of the belly in frames1and32. Frames1-4 notices viewer;5-12 slowly raises blanket in small steps to hide both eyes and nose together intentionally;13-16 peeks over its top with only the two normal eyes, no duplicate face;17-24 lowers blanket in small steps to reveal the whole familiar face with happy eye arcs;25-28 tiny contented wiggle;29-32 settles to exact initial blanket scene. Do not stretch flippers into human arms. Blanket may cover face for this deliberate peekaboo only; keep body size and camera fixed. Never create extra eyes on the blanket.

entries.label: Rosy little temper
entries.action: One Moru has a cute brief grumpy blush and calms down. The ONLY additional colors allowed are soft coral #d96c75 and warm blush #ee9a93, restricted to its FACE. Frames1-4 neutral gray;5-8 both brows narrow a little and tiny warm blush patches appear on cheeks;9-16 blush gradually spreads across gray forehead and cheeks using deliberate flat pixel clusters, becoming coral while ivory BELLY and indigo flippers stay unchanged;17-20 a tiny flipper stomp and puffed cheeks with paired navy annoyed eyes;21-28 slow exhale, coral recedes through warm blush patches back to gray in small steps;29-32 entirely neutral original gray face. Nose remains a small dark solid diamond. No teeth, flames, steam, angry icon, human arms or distress. A lovable tiny temper, not aggressive.
